name: @giuseppe.trisciuoglio/pi-jscpd-duplicates
description: pi extension that keeps AI-generated code free of duplicates: an asynchronous jscpd scan runs after every file write, and the agent is asked to refactor when freshly written code duplicates existing code.
author: Giuseppe Trisciuoglio

scripts.build: echo 'pi loads TypeScript extensions directly; no build step is required.'
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit

pi.name: pi-jscpd-duplicates
pi.description: Async duplicate-code guard: jscpd runs in the background after every write, the agent refactors the freshly introduced clones before settling.
